description: This file defines a final class `BufferConverter` that handles audio format conversions using AVFoundation's AVAudioConverter. It provides a method to convert AVAudioPCMBuffer instances to a specified format, managing conversion state and errors.

classes.name: BufferConverter
classes.description: A utility class to perform audio buffer format conversions.

classes.name: BufferConverter.Box
classes.description: A helper class to hold mutable values with thread-safety flags.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an AVAudioPCMBuffer to a specified AVAudioFormat, reusing or creating an AVAudioConverter as necessary, handling error conditions.
